Best 15-inch M5 MacBook Air deals yet: Land one today at up to $220 off the list price

Alongside some of the bundle offers below, it is also undercutting the best Amazon deal yet on the standard 24GB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air package.

The 24GB/1TB M5 MacBook Air carries a $1,699 list price and is currently $150 off at Amazon (although color options are quite limited at the moment).

B&H, however, is offering the same deal price with an additional $30 off during checkout. This brings the regularly $1,699 machine down to $1,519 shipped.

You’re looking at $180 off the list price and the lowest price we have tracked online for this configuration – it has never sold for less than $1,549 at Amazon – but this might not be the best deal on this machine right now depending on which official Apple charger you prefer:

It is also very much worth pointing out the pair of 15-inch MacBook Air bundle deals B&H is offering. Both of these offers are the very lowest price we have seen online for this same 24GB/1TB M5 machine, the only difference between these and the deal above is the charger it comes with – M5 MacBook Air comes standard from Apple (and elsewhere) with a 40W single USB-C charger, but B&H is offering the more expensive charger configurations for even less:

Apple’s most affordable 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro hits Amazon all-time low at over $250 off today

Alongside a host of notable discounts across the M5 MacBook Pro and 2026 M5 Pro machines below, folks looking towards an upgraded machine without getting up into the wildly expensive stuff will find the 2TB M5 Pro at a new Amazon all-time low today – it is now over $250 off the list price.

Amazon is now offering the most affordable 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro you can buy at a new $2,346.50 shipped all-time low.

This is the configuration with the 14.2-inch Liquid Retina XDR Display, 24GB of Unified Memory, and the 15-core CPU/16-core GPU setup. It carries a regular price at $2,599 and is now nearly $253 off to deliver the lowest price we have ever tracked at Amazon.

B&H and Expercom – a pair of well known and trustworthy authorized Apple dealers – did, at one point, have a better price on this machine than Amazon did, but Amazon has now dropped the price down even lower to undercut both of them.

Again, this the least expensive 2TB model Apple sells on its new 2026 M5 Pro MacBook Pro – the 2TB model with the upgraded 18-core CPU/20-core GPU setup is also on sale at nearly $170 off right now though.

Apple’s new mid-range 256GB 13-inch M4 iPad Air hits new all-time low today at nearly $110 off

We are starting to see deal pricing on the new M4 iPad Air lineup drop even lower this week, and fortunately not just on the most expensive models. The most affordable configuration in the lineup hit its best price yesterday and now we have the 13-inch 256GB model dropping to a new Amazon all-time low at nearly $110 off.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s new 13-inch M4 iPad Air with the 256GB storage capacity down at $789.99 shipped in all four colors.

Regularly $899, you’re looking at just shy of $110 off and the best price we have tracked on this model. Up until now, really only the most expensive 1TB variants have hit the $100 off range, but today we are getting a mid-ranger model that hits right in the sweet spot for me on the iPad Air lineup – I probably don’t need 512GB, and I certainly don’t need the 1TB (unless there is a wild deal on one), and the 128GB leaves a little too much to be desired for me.

Apple’s latest Magic Mouse just dropped back to best Amazon price ever if you need a fresh one

If you didn’t get a chance to score it about a month ago, Amazon is giving folks a chance to refresh their Apple Magic Mouse back at the lowest price it has ever offered it for.

Amazon is now offering the latest Apple Magic Mouse in the classic white/silver livery down at $63.99 shipped. Regularly $79, this is matching the lowest price we have tracked at Amazon and delivering the best deal we can find from a reputable source in brand new condition.

Previous to early 2026, deals on the latest USB-C model Magic Mouse were generally rare and not overly remarkable. We saw a few dips to $68 back in mid-2025 and then again later in the year before Christmas. Fast forward to March of 2026 when we got the first chance to land it for any less than that on Amazon, and we are getting another shot at that deal again here today.

For some, the Magic Mouse isn’t exactly the most ergonomic, and the placement of the USB-C charging port underneath – you can’t use it while it’s plugged in and charging – leave a lot to be desired. But for folks like me, it is an absolute must-have piece of kit in my home office or really just anytime I need mouse control over my Apple gear. The swipe gestures are second to none in my opinion and something I simply cannot do without. If you’re in the same boat and looking for a 2026 Magic refresh, it’s hard to beat the price we have here today.
